query: ThermalCore-88 occupancy rate Northern Boreal Corridor maintenance outages and zero readings overlapping 2024-03-18 14:00:00 through 2024-03-19 13:00:00

evidence.claim: The recurring 17:00–20:00 maintenance suspension was historical and will not continue in the forecast period.
evidence.exact_quote: Historically, Unit R4 (ThermalCore-88) underwent a daily maintenance suspension of service between 17:00 and 20:00, but it will not be in maintenance in the future, so this historical maintenance should not affect the forecast period.

evidence.claim: Zero readings during maintenance were produced by sensor inactivity rather than measured highway occupancy.
evidence.exact_quote: The telemetry logs record zero readings due to the lack of sensor activity during these periods.

impacts.rationale: The historical 17:00–20:00 zeros were maintenance-generated observation artifacts, and the unit will not enter maintenance during the future horizon. This contradicts assumptions that exact-zero probability remains stable by seasonal phase. No numeric replacement is justified because the documents do not state the underlying occupancy magnitude during those hours.
